description: Get this repository's design system: the colors, spacing, typography, radius, shadow and motion values it defines (CSS custom properties, Tailwind theme, tokens.json, Sass variables, DESIGN.md). Without arguments it returns a short summary (counts plus a few tokens per category) to keep context small; pass a category or name substring for the full list. When you are about to edit a specific file, prefer context_for_file, which returns only what that file needs. Repos with no tokens get the values their code already uses most. Categories: color, spacing, typography, shadow, border, sizing, motion, zIndex.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the token name

name: list_design_tokens
title: List design tokens
